# Living glossary

This file grows as concepts earn their way into the project.

## Problem
An undesirable situation or unmet need we want to change.

## Requirement
A behavior or property the system must satisfy.

## Constraint
A limitation on the solution space.

## Assumption
Something we currently treat as true in order to reason or design. Assumptions can be wrong.

## Invariant
A condition that must remain true for the system to be considered correct.

## Trade-off
A decision where improving one property usually costs another property.

## Failure mode
A specific way in which a system or component can fail.

## Correctness
The degree to which the system satisfies its specified behavior and invariants.
